function drawUrbanDepth(){
  if(level>=4)return;
  ctx.save();
  // capa de ciudad lejana / cerros
  ctx.globalAlpha=.28;
  ctx.fillStyle=level===1?'#1a2438':level===2?'#16333f':'#1b2b37';
  for(let i=0;i<8;i++){
    const bx=i*140-camera*.06%140;
    const h=70+(i%3)*18;
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(bx,ground-120);ctx.lineTo(bx+45,ground-120-h);ctx.lineTo(bx+120,ground-120);ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha=.22;
  ctx.fillStyle=level===1?'#222f47':level===2?'#264857':'#273c49';
  for(let i=0;i<15;i++){
    const bx=i*72-camera*.11%72;
    const h=40+(i*17)%80;
    ctx.fillRect(bx,ground-120-h,30,h);
    ctx.fillStyle=(i%2)?'#ffc26a':'#a8cae2';
    for(let wy=0;wy<3;wy++)ctx.fillRect(bx+8,ground-116-h+wy*18,6,8);
    ctx.fillStyle=level===1?'#222f47':level===2?'#264857':'#273c49';
  }
  // vía / paseo estilizado
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(20,28,39,.22)';ctx.fillRect(0,ground-38,W,16);
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,220,146,.28)';
  for(let i=0;i<16;i++)ctx.fillRect((i*68-camera*.22)%W,ground-31,34,3);
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawRoutePanel(){
  if(level>=4)return;
  const step=Math.min(3,Math.floor(Math.max(0,player.x)/800));
  const index=(level-1)*4+step;
  const current=rutaCanonSurNorte[index];
  const next=index<rutaCanonSurNorte.length-1?rutaCanonSurNorte[index+1]:'APOCALIPSIS PLAYERO';
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(10,18,29,.88)';ctx.fillRect(126,120,708,42);
  ctx.strokeStyle='#ee9d35';ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.strokeRect(126,120,708,42);
  text('📍 '+(index+1)+'/12 · '+current,146,138,14,'#ffd8a3');
  text('SIGUE: '+next,146,156,11,'#b7dcee');
}

function drawStreetLamp(x,yTop,glow='#ffd783'){
  ctx.fillStyle='#4b5564';ctx.fillRect(x,yTop,6,ground-yTop-37);
  ctx.fillStyle='#d7c698';ctx.fillRect(x-5,yTop,16,6);
  ctx.fillStyle='#f4d07f';ctx.fillRect(x-2,yTop+6,10,6);
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,217,126,.23)';ctx.lineWidth=2;
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x+3,yTop+12,26+Math.sin(tick*.07+x)*2,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.stroke();
}

// V15.4 — efectos dibujados detrás de los personajes, sin colisiones.
function drawAtmosphere107(){
  ctx.save();
  const beach=level===4;
  const drift=(tick*.13+camera*.08)%1100;
  for(let i=0;i<5;i++){
    const x=(i*270+120-drift+1400)%1400-150;
    const y=175+(i%3)*28;
    ctx.globalAlpha=beach?.33:.10;
    ctx.fillStyle=beach?'#fff7da':'#b6bfd8';
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(x,y,50,13,0,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.ellipse(x+30,y-6,38,17,0,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha=beach?.26:.12;
  ctx.strokeStyle=beach?'#fffbdc':'#d0b987';ctx.lineWidth=2;
  for(let i=0;i<6;i++){
    const px=((i*190+tick*(beach?.5:.17)+i*31)%1120)-100;
    const py=beach?285+(i%3)*11:245+(i%4)*20;
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(px,py);ctx.lineTo(px+26,py-3);ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.restore();
}
function drawGroundTexture107(){
  ctx.save();

    ctx.fillStyle=level===4?'#fce6aa':'#a5a3a1';
    ctx.fillRect(x,ground+18+(x%3)*2,15,2);
    if(level===4){ctx.fillStyle='#b78551';ctx.fillRect(x+28,ground+29,5,3)}
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawNaguaYorkLandmarks(){
  // NaguaYork con personalidad propia: más fachada, barrio y rock.
  if(level!==2)return;
  function sign(x,a,b){
    ctx.fillStyle='#152b41';ctx.fillRect(x,ground-112,225,50);
    ctx.strokeStyle='#ffa344';ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.strokeRect(x,ground-112,225,50);
    text(a,x+112,ground-93,13,'#ffd093','center');
    text(b,x+112,ground-73,10,'#b9e1ee','center');
  }
  function windowGrid(x,y,cols,rows,dx,dy,litA='#ffcf80',litB='#9dc9e4'){
    for(let r=0;r<rows;r++)for(let c=0;c<cols;c++){
      ctx.fillStyle=(r+c+Math.floor(tick*.03))%3===0?litA:litB;
      ctx.fillRect(x+c*dx,y+r*dy,12,12);
    }
  }
  function post(x,h){
    ctx.fillStyle='#606b78';ctx.fillRect(x,ground-h,5,h-35);
    ctx.fillStyle='#ead79d';ctx.fillRect(x-7,ground-h+12,18,6);

function drawCopeyAdventure(){
 if(level!==6)return;
 ctx.save();
 // rope bridge, safely placed behind the existing platforms and hazards
 const lx=1340,rx=1500,y=ground-165;
 ctx.strokeStyle='#6d4b30';ctx.lineWidth=4;
 ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(lx,y);ctx.quadraticCurveTo((lx+rx)/2,y+24,rx,y);ctx.stroke();
 for(let x=lx+7;x<rx-7;x+=13){const by=y+24*Math.sin((x-lx)/(rx-lx)*Math.PI);ctx.strokeStyle='#b5834b';ctx.lineWidth=7;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x,by-2);ctx.lineTo(x,by+7);ctx.stroke();}
 ctx.strokeStyle='#b4a277';ctx.lineWidth=3;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(lx,y-37);ctx.quadraticCurveTo((lx+rx)/2,y-7,rx,y-37);ctx.stroke();
 for(let x=lx;x<=rx;x+=35){const by=y+24*Math.sin((x-lx)/(rx-lx)*Math.PI);ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x,by);ctx.lineTo(x,by-36);ctx.stroke();}
 // cave and trail head, without collision alterations
 ctx.fillStyle='#6b675a';ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(2290,ground-45,89,82,0,Math.PI,2*Math.PI);ctx.lineTo(2379,ground);ctx.lineTo(2201,ground);ctx.fill();
 ctx.fillStyle='#16262b';ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(2290,ground-29,48,64,0,Math.PI,2*Math.PI);ctx.lineTo(2338,ground);ctx.lineTo(2242,ground);ctx.fill();
 ctx.fillStyle='#ffe0a0';text('CUEVA DEL ROCK',2290,ground-110,15,'#ffe0a0','center');
 for(const x of [480,790,1180,1740,2550]){ctx.fillStyle='#7b6241';ctx.fillRect(x,ground-65,7,55);ctx.fillStyle='#e0c18a';ctx.fillRect(x-8,ground-75,92,23);text('SENDERO',x+38,ground-59,12,'#283a35','center');}
 ctx.restore();
}

function drawPanasCabina(){
 if(level!==10)return;
 ctx.save();ctx.translate(-camera,0);
 const near=(x)=>Math.abs((player.x+player.w/2)-x)<185;
 const linoX=970,nachoX=2080;
 // Lino «Dame un Chance»: más gordito, calvo, morenito, con auriculares y chaleco de operador.
 ctx.save();ctx.translate(linoX,ground);
 const linoTalk=near(linoX+21),wave=linoTalk?Math.sin(tick*.16)*7:0;
 const linoBob=linoTalk?Math.sin(tick*.11)*2:0;ctx.translate(0,linoBob);
 ctx.fillStyle='#35485a';ctx.fillRect(-18,-13,15,13);ctx.fillRect(14,-13,15,13); // piernas
 ctx.fillStyle='#242d38';ctx.fillRect(-31,-52,60,46); // barriga/torso base
 ctx.fillStyle='#516955';ctx.fillRect(-35,-55,68,39); // chaleco ancho de operador
 ctx.fillStyle='#7b8c63';ctx.fillRect(-10,-49,20,16);ctx.fillRect(13,-47,11,13); // bolsillos
 ctx.fillStyle='#f2ab43';ctx.fillRect(-12,-46,7,4);ctx.fillStyle='#d4e3bd';ctx.fillRect(18,-44,4,4); // identificación y botones del chaleco
 ctx.fillStyle='#734f3c';ctx.fillRect(-3,-17,9,11);ctx.fillRect(8,-17,9,11); // zapatos oscuros
 ctx.fillStyle='#9d6849';ctx.fillRect(-16,-95,36,40); // piel morenita
 ctx.fillStyle='#1e242c';ctx.fillRect(-18,-95,40,5); // línea del cráneo calvo
 ctx.fillStyle='#434c57';ctx.fillRect(-24,-89,8,27);ctx.fillRect(20,-89,8,27); // audífonos
 ctx.strokeStyle='#434c57';ctx.lineWidth=5;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(2,-88,23,Math.PI*1.05,Math.PI*1.95);ctx.stroke();
 ctx.fillStyle='#20252e';ctx.fillRect(-10,-78,12,3);ctx.fillRect(7,-78,12,3); // cejas
 ctx.fillStyle='#d5ecf8';ctx.fillRect(-10,-75,12,8);ctx.fillRect(7,-75,12,8); // lentes
 ctx.fillStyle='#5d3b2e';ctx.fillRect(-1,-62,10,2); // boca/bigote mínimo
 ctx.fillStyle='#d3a482';ctx.fillRect(-12,-91,5,5);ctx.fillRect(10,-91,5,5); // brillo en cabeza calva
 ctx.fillStyle='#f6c15e';ctx.fillRect(-31,-55,8,25);ctx.fillRect(28,-55,7,25); // ribetes del chaleco
 ctx.fillStyle='#101923';ctx.fillRect(-13,-49,7,8);ctx.fillRect(19,-47,6,8); // bolsillos contrastados
 ctx.strokeStyle='#9d6849';ctx.lineWidth=8;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(31,-42);ctx.lineTo(40+wave,-57);ctx.stroke(); // brazo saludando
 ctx.strokeStyle='#9d6849';ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-28,-42);ctx.lineTo(-36,-27);ctx.stroke();
 ctx.restore();
 // Nacho «Aerodynamico»: pelo blanco no muy largo, blanco, hombros cuadrados, camisa oscura y actitud de gerente rockero.
 ctx.save();ctx.translate(nachoX,ground);
 const nachoTalk=near(nachoX+22),arm=nachoTalk?Math.sin(tick*.14)*6:0;
 const nachoBob=nachoTalk?Math.sin(tick*.09+1)*2:0;ctx.translate(0,nachoBob);
 ctx.fillStyle='#242d38';ctx.fillRect(-18,-14,16,14);ctx.fillRect(16,-14,16,14); // piernas
 ctx.fillStyle='#202732';ctx.fillRect(-18,-61,52,61); // camisa oscura
 ctx.fillStyle='#3b4350';ctx.fillRect(-26,-63,68,18); // hombros cuadrados marcados
 ctx.fillStyle='#dbad87';ctx.fillRect(-11,-92,32,31); // piel clara
 ctx.fillStyle='#f2f2ea';ctx.fillRect(-15,-101,40,10);ctx.fillRect(-11,-107,14,7);ctx.fillRect(10,-106,12,6);ctx.fillRect(-16,-97,6,8);ctx.fillRect(20,-97,6,8); // pelo blanco no muy largo
 ctx.fillStyle='#1b212b';ctx.fillRect(-8,-79,12,4);ctx.fillRect(8,-79,12,4);
 ctx.fillStyle='#7a4c39';ctx.fillRect(2,-67,9,2);
 ctx.strokeStyle='#dbad87';ctx.lineWidth=8;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(37,-44);ctx.lineTo(48+arm,-58);ctx.stroke(); // gesto gerencial
 ctx.strokeStyle='#dbad87';ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-21,-44);ctx.lineTo(-31,-34-arm*.4);ctx.stroke();
 ctx.fillStyle='#fff8e8';ctx.fillRect(-9,-105,11,3);ctx.fillRect(10,-104,9,3); // reflejos del pelo blanco corto
 ctx.fillStyle='#e6ac53';ctx.fillRect(-23,-62,8,5);ctx.fillRect(33,-62,8,5); // detalle de hombros cuadrados
 ctx.fillStyle='#0f141c';ctx.fillRect(-7,-48,26,6); // detalle camisa oscura
 ctx.fillStyle='#a7b1c0';ctx.fillRect(-3,-53,3,11);ctx.fillStyle='#efae53';ctx.fillRect(13,-54,9,6); // cuello y credencial de gerente
 ctx.restore();
 // Mesas de producción: LEDs animados y vúmetros para dar vida a la cabina.
 for(const [mx,lit] of [[linoX-105,linoTalk],[nachoX-112,nachoTalk]]){
   ctx.fillStyle='#151e2a';ctx.fillRect(mx,ground-39,62,37);
   ctx.strokeStyle='#db9243';ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.strokeRect(mx,ground-39,62,37);
   for(let k=0;k<5;k++){
     const h=8+Math.abs(Math.sin(tick*.065+k*.8+(lit?1:0)))*17;
     ctx.fillStyle=k<3?'#80d8a7':'#f0b44d';ctx.fillRect(mx+7+k*10,ground-6-h,6,h);
   }
 }
 if(linoTalk)npcSpotlight.lino=280;
 if(nachoTalk)npcSpotlight.nacho=280;
 for(const [id,x,name,subtitle,dialogue,isNear] of [
   ['lino',linoX,'LINO','OPERADOR', '¡DAME UN CHANCE, WATON!',linoTalk],
   ['nacho',nachoX,'NACHO','GERENTE', '¡COÑO, MARICO, VAMOS AL AIRE!',nachoTalk]
 ]){
  const visible=isNear||npcSpotlight[id]>0;
  const pulse=1+Math.sin(tick*.16)*0.08;
  if(visible){
    ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,211,109,.55)';ctx.lineWidth=3;
    ctx.strokeRect(x-38*pulse,ground-116,76*pulse,116);
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,211,109,.12)';ctx.fillRect(x-38*pulse,ground-116,76*pulse,116);
  }
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(12,20,32,.94)';ctx.strokeStyle=visible?'#ffd36d':'#efaa52';ctx.lineWidth=2;
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.roundRect(x-66,ground-150,146,36,9);ctx.fill();ctx.stroke();
  text(name,x+7,ground-134,18,'#ffe7b5','center');
  text(subtitle,x+7,ground-121,10,visible?'#9ee5ff':'#c0d6e2','center');
  if(visible){
   const w=386,bx=x-186,by=ground-193;
   ctx.fillStyle='rgba(10,20,37,.97)';ctx.strokeStyle=isNear?'#ffd36d':'#b8d0df';ctx.lineWidth=2;
   ctx.beginPath();ctx.roundRect(bx,by,w,50,10);ctx.fill();ctx.stroke();
   text('★ PERSONAJE ESPECIAL ★',x+7,by+16,10,'#8ce8ff','center');
   text(dialogue,x+7,by+35,15,'#fff4d8','center');
  }
 }
 // Réplica corta del Coach: alterna con el saludo, sin tapar a los personajes.
 const focusId=linoTalk||npcSpotlight.lino>0?'lino':nachoTalk||npcSpotlight.nacho>0?'nacho':null;
 const focusX=focusId==='lino'?linoX:focusId==='nacho'?nachoX:null;
 if(focusX!==null && Math.floor(tick/145)%2===1){
   const punch=(focusId==='lino')?'¡WATON, SE ENFRÍA LA BIRRA!':'¡NACHO, EL MICRÓFONO ESTÁ PRENDIDO!';
   const px=focusX-182, py=ground-247;
   ctx.fillStyle='rgba(11,18,32,.94)';ctx.strokeStyle='#7bd6fa';ctx.lineWidth=2;
   ctx.beginPath();ctx.roundRect(px,py,380,39,8);ctx.fill();ctx.stroke();
   text('CHARLIE: '+punch,focusX+8,py+25,12,'#e1f7ff','center');
 }
 ctx.restore();
}

masssReference.src='data:image/png;base64,
